name: Kotou no Serenade
source:
Shoko is a student whose uncle works as a cameraman for the editorial department of a publishing company.
One day she encounters the scene of a bizarre method serial killer. At that time, she and her best friend Asuka become wrapped up in an unthinkable event.

One day the two of them go with cameraman Koji to a deserted island to shoot some footage of a rare hot spring.  Although it was supposed to be a fun trip, the seal that has previously been locked on the island is released! A place that intersects with another world, strange changes begining to take place. What is the sad conclusion that awaits these two girls?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE043791.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
翔子是一名学生，他的叔叔在一家出版公司的编辑部担任摄影师。
有一天，她遭遇了一名手段奇特的连环杀手的现场。那时，她和她最好的朋友明日香陷入了一场不可思议的事件。

有一天，他们两人和摄影师浩二一起去一座荒岛上拍摄罕见的温泉镜头。虽然本该是一次愉快的旅行，但之前锁在岛上的封印却被释放了！与另一个世界相交的地方，开始发生奇异的变化。等待这两个女孩的悲伤结局是什么？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE043791.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
